newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso slips vs dlr, ends off at 1,080.30.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso slips vs dlr, ends off at 1,080.30.

text.p: Colombia's peso slipped 50 centavos against the dollar to end at 1,080.30 in mostly sideways trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
They said the peso's fall stemmed from dollar-buying by banks, but dollar sales by coffee exporters underpinned the local currency.
Dealers reported 264 trades for a total of $125 million and said the peso held in a narrow 1,079.20 to 1,081.30 range.
